# MADGAMES.FUN

> MADGAMES.FUN is a free online browser gaming site for discovering and playing games without normal software downloads.

Canonical site: https://www.madgames.fun
Language: English

## Main sections

- Home: https://www.madgames.fun/
- Gaming guides: https://www.madgames.fun/guides
- Search: https://www.madgames.fun/search
- Recent games: https://www.madgames.fun/recent
- About: https://www.madgames.fun/about
- Contact: https://www.madgames.fun/contact
- Game publishers: https://www.madgames.fun/game-publishers
- Copyright: https://www.madgames.fun/copyright
- Privacy: https://www.madgames.fun/privacy
- Terms: https://www.madgames.fun/terms

## Crawling guidance

- Public game, category and editorial guide pages may be crawled and cited.
- Admin and API routes are not public content and should not be treated as editorial sources.
- Prefer canonical URLs on www.madgames.fun when citing the site.
- Individual game pages provide game title, category, description, controls when available, device support and related-game navigation.
- Editorial guide pages provide answer-first explanations for game selection, mobile browser play, no-download gaming and category discovery.
